how: Usage from grep of src/ and a read of index.html at commit 86286479a6e7cabe98264c5632117e43fe5499a1; rendered sizes from a Playwright Chromium probe (boundingClientRect + naturalWidth after a full scroll-through) against a vite-preview build, at the two design widths. Rendered sizes are CSS px at DPR 1. Image bytes measured with stat on the files.
indexHtml: No art image references (favicon.svg only). index.html was not modified by this task.

images.usedBy: src/components/mac/Mac.tsx — WALLPAPER, the hero desktop's colour painting (eager, fetchPriority high, settleHero load gating). This is the LCP element at both measured widths.
images.css: .mac-stage__paper in src/components/mac/mac.css — image-rendering: pixelated, object-fit: cover; explicit width/height attributes (1536x1024) on the img.
images.shipping: public/art/austin-dusk.webp — 1895394 B lossless WebP (libwebp effort 6), decoded raw pixels byte-for-byte identical to the original (tools/optimize-images.mjs identity check).

images.usedBy: src/components/sections/Austin.tsx — HALL, the Austin section illustration; below the first screen at both widths.
images.css: .austin__art in src/components/sections/sections.css — image-rendering: pixelated, object-fit: cover; no explicit width/height attributes (positioned absolute in a sized container, so no layout shift is possible).
images.shipping: public/art/pershing-hall.webp — 2034928 B lossless WebP (libwebp effort 6), decoded raw pixels byte-for-byte identical to the original (tools/optimize-images.mjs identity check).

images.usedBy: src/components/mac/Mac.tsx — the ink print behind every non-hero desktop (three instances on the full page); below the first screen at both widths.
images.css: .mac-stage__paper — image-rendering: pixelated, object-fit: cover; explicit width/height attributes (1536x1024) on the img.
images.shipping: public/art/austin-dusk-ink.webp — kept at its original 885016 B: the file was already lossless WebP (written by tools/ink-print.mjs), and a libwebp effort-6 re-encode produced a byte-identical file (cmp equal), so the original bytes stand.

decisions.nativeSizeKept: All three images are 1536x1024 native and are displayed via object-fit: cover crops with image-rendering: pixelated (largest rendered box: 1168x657 CSS px at 1440 width). Any resampling changes which source pixels are sampled, so no downscale — pixel-identity to the display pipeline is only guaranteed at native size.
decisions.palettePngRejected: The two PNGs have 359808 and 435089 distinct RGB colours respectively (dithered truecolour gradients, counted from raw pixels) — far above a 256-colour palette, so palette reduction cannot be provably lossless here. This is the spec's own condition for allowing palette PNG.
decisions.avifRejected: Lossless AVIF (libheif, sharp effort 4) produced larger files than lossless WebP on both PNGs (austin-dusk: 2062721 B vs 1895394 B; pershing-hall: 2286670 B vs 2034928 B) and took 33-44 s per image to encode.
decisions.noPictureElement: Lossless WebP is served in the same the site already used for WebP (the ink print), so the browser-support story is unchanged from the status quo; no fallback was added.
decisions.lazyAndDecoding: Below-the-first-screen images: all ink instances and the Austin art already had loading="lazy"; decoding="async" was added to both editable spots (Mac.tsx conditional on !hero, Austin.tsx always). The hero keeps eager/high priority and no decoding attribute.
decisions.uneditableFiles: None — no below-fold image lives only in index.html or src/main.tsx.
